metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 22 Odisha destinations. OTDC Panthanivas / Yatrinivas network and Odisha Eco-Tourism forest camps used as authoritative government anchors. High fabrication/mislabel rate (~63% of picks failed verification as keep_existing). Honest-scarcity heavy across remote pilgrim spots, day-trip sites and protected marine sanctuary as expected.

existing.name: The Lalit Bhubaneswar
existing.issue: No Lalit-group hotel operates in Bhubaneswar — The Lalit's nearest properties are elsewhere. Ghost property. Re-anchor to Mayfair Lagoon, the city's flagship experience address.

replacement.name: Mayfair Lagoon
replacement.tagline: Bhubaneswar's iconic urban resort — 100 rooms, suites and villas across 10 acres of lakes, gardens and themed restaurants. Tripadvisor's #1 luxury hotel in the temple city for years running.
replacement.address: 8-B, Jaydev Vihar, Bhubaneswar 751013, Odisha

existing.name: Mayfair Heritage Bhubaneswar
existing.issue: Mislabelled — Mayfair Heritage is in Puri (beach resort), not Bhubaneswar. Mayfair's Bhubaneswar property is Mayfair Lagoon (used for the experience slot). Re-anchor the value slot to Panthanivas Bhubaneswar (OTDC).

replacement.name: Panthanivas Bhubaneswar (OTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Odisha Tourism state-tourism hotel on Lewis Road — plain, government-run and inexpensive, with a restaurant and bar, near the Lingaraj old-town temple cluster. A reliable festival-season fallback.
replacement.address: Lewis Road, Bhubaneswar 751014, Odisha

existing.name: Hotel Swosti Premium
existing.issue: OK — Swosti Premium is a real 5-star in the Jaydev Vihar hotel cluster, Bhubaneswar. Tighten the name.

replacement.name: Swosti Premium
replacement.tagline: A locally owned 5-star in the central Jaydev Vihar hotel cluster — rooftop, multiple restaurants and a location that puts the State Museum, Ekamra heritage walks and the airport within easy reach.
replacement.address: P-1, Jaydev Vihar, Bhubaneswar 751013, Odisha

existing.name: Khandagiri Caves Heritage Homestay
existing.issue: Unverifiable — no property of this name appears on Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Tripadvisor or any official listing. Likely a fabricated 'heritage homestay' ghost. Re-anchor to Trident Bhubaneswar, a genuine garden-resort x-factor.

replacement.name: Trident Bhubaneswar
replacement.tagline: An Oberoi-group Trident on 14 acres of fruit orchards and lawns — just 62 keys, so it stays quiet. Temple-city architecture and garden calm, 20 minutes from the airport.
replacement.address: CB-1, Nayapalli, Bhubaneswar 751013, Odisha

existing.name: Mayfair Convention Cuttack

replacement.name: Mayfair Cuttack
replacement.tagline: Cuttack's standout luxury address — a Mayfair-group resort with landscaped grounds, a pool and multi-cuisine dining on the Mahanadi side of the silver-filigree city.
replacement.address: Mahanadi Vihar, Cuttack 753004, Odisha

existing.name: Hotel Presidency
existing.issue: Unverifiable as a current Cuttack property — no clear Booking.com/MakeMyTrip/Tripadvisor listing for 'Hotel Presidency, Cuttack'. Replace with Hotel Akbari Continental, a long-established verified Cuttack business hotel.

replacement.name: Hotel Akbari Continental
replacement.tagline: One of Cuttack's longest-running full-service hotels — a reliable 3-star with restaurants and conference space, walkable to Barabati Fort and the tarakasi silver-filigree workshops.
replacement.address: Haripur Road, Dolamundai, Cuttack 753001, Odisha

existing.name: Hotel Swagat
existing.issue: Generic budget-hotel name with no verifiable single listing for Cuttack — multiple unrelated 'Hotel Swagat' properties exist across India, none clearly confirmable in Cuttack. No reliable tier-1/2 location-slot property beyond the two already used; honest scarcity.

replacement.name: Panthanivas Cuttack (OTDC)

replacement.address: Cuttack 753001, Odisha

existing.name: The Mayfair Heritage, Puri

existing.name: Akshaya Nivas Guest House

Gopalpur is a small beach town; beyond Mayfair and Swosti Palm there is no further verifiable tier-1/2 property for a distinct location slot — honest scarcity.

Chandipur is a tiny beach hamlet; the OTDC Panthanivas is effectively the only verified tier-1/2 stay, others are unrated budget lodges. Honest scarcity for the value slot.

replacement.name: Sand Pebbles Bhitarkanika Jungle Resort
replacement.tagline: A 17-key Swiss-tent and room resort at the Khola gate — AC luxury tents, deluxe tents and family suites, with 'The Crocodile' restaurant doing local prawn and crab. The most established private base for park safaris.
replacement.address: Khola, Dangmal, Rajnagar, Kendrapara District 754225, Odisha

existing.name: Rajnagar Guest House

replacement.name: Aranyanivas Bhitarkanika (OTDC)
replacement.tagline: The Odisha Tourism property inside the mangrove national park — government-run accommodation and the dependable state-tourism base for boat safaris to spot estuarine crocodiles and the heronry.

existing.name: Astarang Resort

replacement.name: Killa Aul Palace
replacement.tagline: A 16th-century royal estate turned heritage homestay hosted by the current royal family — 40 acres on the Kharasrota River, kayaking and guided crocodile-and-bird visits to Bhitarkanika. A distinctive heritage gateway to the park.
replacement.address: Aul, Kendrapara District 754219, Odisha

existing.name: Mangrove Houseboats (operator: Odisha Water Holidays)

Fabricated houseboat concept. Re-anchor the x-factor to the Odisha Eco-Tourism Dangmal/Gupti nature camps, the genuine immersive stay.

replacement.name: Dangmal & Gupti Nature Camps (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
replacement.tagline: Forest-department eco-camps deep in Bhitarkanika — Gupti on the banks of the Patasala river at the sanctuary entry point, Dangmal in the park interior, with luxury rooms and all meals included. The most immersive way to stay inside the mangroves.
replacement.address: Dangmal & Gupti, Bhitarkanika National Park, Kendrapara District 754225, Odisha

existing.name: Lulung Nature Camp (Odisha Forest Dept)

replacement.name: Lulung Aranya Nivas Resort
replacement.tagline: A 14-acre forest resort on the Palpala River at the edge of Simlipal's core zone — ~20 riverside cottages, family rooms, meadow suites and a pool. Tripadvisor's #1 in the Simlipal area at 4/5 across 265 reviews.
replacement.address: Lulung, Simlipal Tiger Reserve, Mayurbhanj District 757091, Odisha

existing.name: Pithabata Forest Rest House
existing.issue: OK — Pithabata is the principal southern entry gate of Simlipal and the forest department operates rest-house accommodation there. Reframe as part of the Odisha Eco-Tourism nature-camp network, which is the bookable channel.

replacement.name: Similipal Nature Camps (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
replacement.tagline: The forest-department eco-camp network inside Simlipal — bamboo huts and tented lodges at interior locations including the Pithabata-gate area, the only way to stay deep in the reserve. Closed mid-June to mid-October for monsoon.
replacement.address: Simlipal Tiger Reserve, Mayurbhanj District, Odisha

existing.name: Chahala Forest Rest House (interior)
existing.issue: OK in spirit — Chahala is a genuine interior forest rest house deep inside Simlipal, historically a royal hunting lodge. Reframe under the Odisha Eco-Tourism interior-camp network, the correct bookable channel; access is restricted and seasonal.

replacement.name: Chahala Interior Nature Camp (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
replacement.tagline: A historic interior camp deep in the Simlipal core — the former royal hunting lodge at Chahala, a salt-lick clearing that draws elephant and gaur. The most remote, immersive Simlipal stay; access restricted and monsoon-closed.
replacement.address: Chahala, interior Simlipal Tiger Reserve, Mayurbhanj District, Odisha

existing.name: Satkosia Tiger Lodge

replacement.name: Tikarpada Nature Camp (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
replacement.tagline: The forest-department eco-camp on the bank of the Mahanadi inside the Satkosia gorge — eco cottages and Swiss cotton tents with all meals included, run with local communities. Gorge boating to spot gharial and mugger crocodiles.
replacement.address: Tikarpada, Satkosia Tiger Reserve, Angul District 759122, Odisha

existing.name: Kanak Mahal Resort

existing.name: Balukhanda Eco Resort

replacement.name: Purunakote & Baghmunda Nature Camps (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
replacement.tagline: Forest-department eco-camps at the Satkosia gates — Purunakote on the approach to the gorge, Baghmunda in the reserve, with cottages and tents and all meals included. The gate-side bases for Satkosia safaris and trekking.
replacement.address: Purunakote / Baghmunda, Satkosia Tiger Reserve, Angul District, Odisha

existing.name: Satkosia Jungle Camp

The genuine Satkosia accommodation is the forest-department nature-camp network already covered in the experience and location slots; no further distinct tier-1/2 x-factor property exists — honest scarcity.

replacement.name: Lulung Aranya Nivas Resort

replacement.name: Hotel Ambika

Likely a fabricated government-property ghost. Baripada town has few rated hotels beyond Hotel Ambika; no further distinct tier-1/2 location-slot property — honest scarcity.

replacement.name: Similipal Nature Camps (Odisha Eco-Tourism)
